predictions.G5_0: L 的每个（骨干，域），基算子在 confirm5 上单向 R_2N ≥ 0.95；v1 的 C1 在 weekday、month 上 R_2 ≤ 0.20。不通过即停止排查。
predictions.L1: 状态监督类，每个骨干：逐 world 的整条链成败，预测与观测一致的比例。H-latent：≥ 0.85，且"潜空间 − 朴素"的 95% CI 下界 > 0；H-decoder：< 0.75，或不优于朴素预测。两个骨干都成立为 H-latent。
predictions.L2: 状态监督类，每个骨干：格子类别预测的准确率。H-latent：≥ 0.80；对立：≤ 0.65。两个骨干都成立为 H-latent。
predictions.L3a: 全部训练过的编辑器格子中，D ≥ 0.5 的格子：≥ 90% 的这类格子单向 R_2N ≤ 0.20；对立：有 > 10% 可组合。
predictions.L3b: CE 系的全部格子：≥ 90% 的格子 D ≥ 0.5；对立：CE 系有时写入状态。
predictions.L3c: 已收敛的 C3 系（dev L2 ≤ 1.2 倍 RRR-16 的值，锁定前判定）：≥ 90% 的格子 D ≤ 0.20。L3a–c 都成立为 H-detector。
predictions.L4: T5Gemma（Q11′）：C1-U4 与 C3-U4（month）。H-shortcut：C1-U4 两个 seed 的单向 R_2N 都 ≤ 0.20，且 D ≥ 0.8；C3-U4 两个 seed 都 ≥ 0.90。H-state：C1-U4 ≥ 0.90。
predictions.L_new: 新训编辑器（结果在锁定时未知）的 L1、L2 另单列报告。
predictions.D1: C = confirm5 上标准冻结的观测类别 ≠ 理想化类别的格子（锁定后按此规则确定）。H-coupling：D_S 的类别 = 理想化类别，≥ 75%；H-readout：D_S 的类别 = 标准冻结的类别，≥ 75%。|C| < 6 时不可评。
predictions.D2: hour，每个骨干的 D{j}（j = 2…6）单向 plus。H-coupling：≥ 4/5 格 R_2N ≥ 0.90；H-readout：≤ 1/5 格。门槛：标准 F{j} 在同一骨干上至少 3/5 格不可组合，否则不可评。
predictions.F1: 格子：month r = 11、12；hour r = 14；compass8 r = 10（T5Gemma）。门槛：普通 RRR-r 在 confirm5 上单向 R_2N ≤ 0.70，否则该格不可评。可评格子，plus：FF-r 的 R_2N，以及 ΔR = FF − RRR（world bootstrap CI）。H-alloc：FF ≥ 0.90 且 ΔR 的 CI 下界 ≥ 0.20；H-capacity：ΔR ≤ 0.05。≥ 3/4 的可评格子符合哪一方，就判为哪一方。
predictions.B1: （seed 中位数）Att1-U、Att2-U 在 name3 与 bind3fix 上的单向 R_30。H-stable：≥ 0.95；H-unstable：≤ 0.50。
predictions.B2: （seed 中位数）bind3：max(Att1-U, Att2-U) 的单向 R_6。H-train：≥ 0.90；H-deep：≤ 0.50。
predictions.B3: （seed 中位数）bind3：Tok-U 的单向 R_6。两种假设都预期 ≤ 0.20。
predictions.N1: 基算子的单向 plus R_2N。H-general：所有（骨干，域）≥ 0.90；H-template：≥ 2/3 的 BART 域 ≤ 0.50。
predictions.N2: C1：R_1 与 R_2（seed 中位数）。H-general：R_1 ≥ 0.90 且 R_2 ≤ 0.20；H-template：R_1 ≤ 0.50。
predictions.N3: F{1}：单向 R_2N ≤ 0.20，交替 R_2N ≥ 0.80，且 A(1) − A(⌊N/2⌋) ≥ 0.50。H-general：所有可评格子成立。
predictions.N4: 读出一致率（真实潜变量，冲突条件）。H-general：≥ 0.85，且"拟合 − 只用基频"的 CI 下界 > 0.10。
predictions.N6: 状态监督类的潜空间预测：逐 world 一致率。H-general：≥ 0.85。
predictions.Q18: N1、N3、N4 都成立为 H-general；N1 符合 H-template 为 H-template；其他为混合。

operational.cells: L/N cell = (backbone, domain, operator or editor, path in {plus, minus, alt}); paths start at the world start; L/N/D chains 2N steps; B chains plus 30, minus 6, alt 6. Categories: composable >= 0.90, fail <= 0.20, otherwise partial (observed R_2N and predicted R-hat_2N alike).
operational.latent_prediction: A.1 with the locked fitted (full) vote model: per world, predicted chain success iff the argmax equals the gold state at every step t <= 2N; predicted cell rate R-hat_2N = fraction of worlds predicted successful. The predictions are the locked simulation files; the argmax recorded during the post-lock chains is used only as a consistency check (it must equal the locked simulation).
operational.observed: per world, observed chain success = decoded trajectory success at step 2N; naive prediction = decoded success at step 1.
operational.state_family: L1/L2 state-supervised cells: every freeze condition F_S of the base operator (F_empty included; base = closed-form RRR), the RRR-r / FF-r grid, and the existing editors whose objective contains canonical L2 (v1 C3, v3 C3 l3/l10/rrrinit, v4 P2 C3-6000 / L2-600 / L2-6000, v4 C3-U4). New editors trained in this round are reported separately (L_new) and are not part of L1/L2.
operational.L1_rule: per backbone: agreement = mean over (world, cell) records of [predicted == observed]; latent - naive CI = A.5 world cluster bootstrap (worlds clustered by world_id, 2000 reps, seed 3101). H-latent iff agreement >= 0.85 and CI lower > 0; H-decoder iff agreement < 0.75 or CI lower <= 0; else mixed. L1 verdict: H-latent if both backbones H-latent, H-decoder if both H-decoder, else mixed.
operational.L2_rule: per backbone: accuracy = fraction of state-family cells with predicted category == observed category; H-latent >= 0.80, H-decoder <= 0.65, else mixed; combined over backbones as L1.
operational.Q14_rule: H-latent iff L1 and L2 are H-latent; H-decoder iff L1 or L2 is H-decoder and neither is H-latent; else mixed.
operational.D_rule: D (A.2) per editor cell = (backbone, editor, domain, direction in {plus, minus}): among worlds whose step-1 decode on that one-way path is parsable, the fraction whose step-1 latent readout (locked simulation) differs from the decoded state; the cell outcome is that path's R_2N. Trained editors = all existing and new editors of L (both families, both backbones; cannot-learn editors excluded).
operational.L3_rule: L3a: among editor cells with D >= 0.5, fraction with R_2N <= 0.20 >= 0.90 (if no such cell: not evaluable). L3b: among CE-family cells, fraction with D >= 0.5 >= 0.90. L3c: among converged C3-family cells (locked list), fraction with D <= 0.20 >= 0.90. Q14' H-detector iff L3a, L3b and L3c hold.
operational.L4_rule: T5Gemma month: C1-U4n and C3-U4n seeds 42, 43 (plus R_2N; D on the plus path). A seed that cannot learn counts as R_2N = 0 and has no D; D >= 0.8 is required of every admitted C1-U4 seed. H-shortcut iff both C1-U4 seeds <= 0.20, every admitted C1-U4 seed D >= 0.8 and both C3-U4 seeds >= 0.90; H-state iff both C1-U4 seeds >= 0.90; else mixed.
operational.D1_rule: cells = (backbone, D domain, S in {1}, not-1, {j}; path) whose idealized category (v3/v4 locked derived, copied into this protocol) exists; C = cells whose observed standard F_S category differs from the idealized one (pooled over backbones; per backbone also reported). H-coupling iff >= 75% of C have D_S category == idealized; H-readout iff >= 75% have D_S category == standard F_S category; else mixed; |C| < 6: not evaluable.
operational.D2_rule: per backbone, hour, j = 2..6, plus: gate = at least 3 of the 5 standard F{j} plus R_2N < 0.90; H-coupling iff >= 4 of 5 D{j} R_2N >= 0.90; H-readout iff <= 1 of 5; else mixed. Q15: H-coupling (H-readout) iff every evaluable D1/D2 verdict is H-coupling (H-readout); not decidable if none is evaluable; else mixed.
operational.F1_rule: per cell: gate RRR-r plus R_2N <= 0.70 on confirm5; Delta R CI = A.5 paired world bootstrap. Q16: H-alloc (H-capacity) iff the fraction of evaluable cells matching it is >= 3/4; no evaluable cell: not evaluable; else mixed.
operational.B_rule: seed medians over 42/43/44 (an editor that failed admission stops B before the lock; bind3 editors are not gated). B1: H-stable iff all four (Att1-U, Att2-U) x (name3, bind3fix) medians of plus R_30 >= 0.95, H-unstable iff all <= 0.50, else mixed. B2 = Q17: max of the Att1-U and Att2-U bind3 medians of plus R_6: H-train >= 0.90, H-deep <= 0.50, else mixed. B3 holds iff the Tok-U bind3 median R_6 <= 0.20.
operational.N_rule: N1 per (backbone, domain) base operator plus R_2N; H-template iff >= 2/3 of the BART N domains <= 0.50. N2 per domain (seed medians); verdict H-general iff every domain meets it, H-template iff every domain has R_1 <= 0.50. N3 over the cells that passed the locked pre-check (F{1}, per (backbone, domain)); no evaluable cell: not evaluable. N4 per backbone pooled over its N domains, records = (world, step) of the F{1} and F{not 1} chains (three paths) with a parsable decoded state, as v4 V4. N5 per BART domain (seed median). N6 per backbone: per-world agreement over the state-family N cells (base, F{1}, F{not 1}, C3-U4). Q18 as stated. If GB removed every (backbone, domain) before the lock (gates.N_domains empty on both backbones), Q18 = not evaluable and no N chain is run.
